## LarpingKit v0.4.0 — Home, Instagram, Shopify & Studio polish

**Live demo:** https://larpcity-delexo.vercel.app

### What's new
- **Home** merges dashboard + My LARPs (`/larps` redirects there)
- Sidebar drops AI Images / Community / New Larp; unfinished platforms show as clickable **Soon**
- **Instagram** dark own-profile LARP with a fresh random identity every create visit
- **Shopify** + **YouTube Studio** LARPs
- Real brand logos, scoped PWA install per LARP, rounder Ink + Paper chrome
